description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Specifications" name="Airplane specifications" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Delivery" name="Airplane delivery" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation" />

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Airplane producer" processRef="Process_Manufacturer" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Send specifications" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Start_SpecificationsReceived" messageRef="Message_Specifications" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Delivery" name="Deliver airplane" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" messageRef="Message_Delivery" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Confirm delivery" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendOption3Requirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendOption4Requirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendOption5Requirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BarJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendOtherRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PartsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssembleInterior</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestFlight</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateProtocol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendProtocol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverAirplane</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Confirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ManufacturingTeams" name="Manufacturing teams">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureVodkaBar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureOption3</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureOption4</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureOption5</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureOtherParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SpecificationsReceived" name="Specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_SpecificationsReceived" messageRef="Message_Specifications" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PartsSplit" name="Process bar and other part requirements in parallel" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarSelection" name="Route by selected bar option" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendVodkaRequirements" name="Send vodka bar requirements to Russian team" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendWhiskeyRequirements" name="Send whiskey bar requirements to Irish team" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendOption3Requirements" name="Send bar option 3 requirements to responsible team" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendOption4Requirements" name="Send bar option 4 requirements to responsible team" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendOption5Requirements" name="Send bar option 5 requirements to responsible team" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar" name="Manufacture vodka bar" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar" name="Manufacture whiskey bar" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureOption3" name="Manufacture bar option 3" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureOption4" name="Manufacture bar option 4" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureOption5" name="Manufacture bar option 5" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarJoin" name="Merge selected bar option" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendOtherRequirements" name="Send seat, color, and toilet water requirements to teams" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureOtherParts" name="Manufacture other configured parts" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PartsJoin" name="All configured parts manufactured" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive individual parts" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestSplit" name="Conduct test flight and create protocol during flight" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Conduct test flight" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestJoin" name="Test flight and protocol complete" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive customer confirmation" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Confirmed" name="Delivery confirmed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_1" sourceRef="Start_SpecificationsReceived" targetRef="Gateway_PartsSplit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_2" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_BarSelection" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_3" sourceRef="Gateway_BarSelection" targetRef="Task_SendVodkaRequirements">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">barOption = 'vodka'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_4" sourceRef="Gateway_BarSelection" targetRef="Task_SendWhiskeyRequirements">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">barOption = 'whiskey'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_5" sourceRef="Gateway_BarSelection" targetRef="Task_SendOption3Requirements">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">barOption = 'option 3'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_6" sourceRef="Gateway_BarSelection" targetRef="Task_SendOption4Requirements">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">barOption = 'option 4'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_7" sourceRef="Gateway_BarSelection" targetRef="Task_SendOption5Requirements">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">barOption = 'option 5'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_9" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar" targetRef="Gateway_BarJoin" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_12" sourceRef="Task_SendOption3Requirements" targetRef="Task_ManufactureOption3" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_14" sourceRef="Task_SendOption4Requirements" targetRef="Task_ManufactureOption4" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_15" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureOption4" targetRef="Gateway_BarJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_16" sourceRef="Task_SendOption5Requirements" targetRef="Task_ManufactureOption5" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_17" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureOption5" targetRef="Gateway_BarJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_18" sourceRef="Gateway_BarJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PartsJoin" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_21" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureOtherParts" targetRef="Gateway_PartsJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_22" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_23" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_29" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_30" sourceRef="Gateway_TestJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" />

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveAirplane</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseSpecifications" name="Choose one of five bar options and specify seats, color, and toilet water amount" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSpecifications" name="Send specifications to producer" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProtocol" name="Receive test protocol" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Delivery confirmed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_2" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications" targetRef="Task_SendSpecifications" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_6" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_Customer" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
